metadata.name: Oocyte and Environmental Data from Foundiougne and Djifer
metadata.description: This dataset contains measurements of oocyte characteristics, environmental parameters (temperature and salinity), and chemical compositions (Ba/Ca, Sr/Ca, Zn/Ca) for the species E. fimbriata. The data is collected from two locations, Foundiougne and Djifer, with spatial coverage in the region around 14.13441 latitude and -16.47588 longitude. Temporal coverage is limited to a single date, 2014-01-01.
